TEXT: The next day.

I brought up the topic during breakfast, in front of 
the whole family.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Dad, Mom, may I have a moment?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh, what's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What is it, Kyousuke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
There's someone I want to introduce to you all 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh, it's your girlfriend, perhaps?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [font_size=17]...Pfft... No way that's it.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... that's it, actually.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Kyousuke, you... got a girlfriend?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Girlfriend, you say...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So... as a matter of fact...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I had her come all the way, she's outside the house 
right now.
That idiot Kanako, you came way too early!

Even though she's usually late... Well, this is another 
form of "not showing up on time", I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: In that case, hurry and have her come in.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: That's right~, it's hot outside, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... I'll bring her in now then.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Kyousuke getting a girlfriend, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: He's certainly a smooth operator, right Dear?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yes... I'm getting old too.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Still... what kind of person is his girlfriend, I wonder...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Isn't it that girl? You know, from the Tamura family.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
Manami-chan? But if it's her, we've met many times 
already, why would she introduce herself again?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
Do you know anything, Kirino? About Kyousuke's 
girlfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ......I don't know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [font_size=14]...I really don't know...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
I see~ Fufufu, I wonder if she's someone I 
know~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: You seem happy, Mother.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: You too, Dear.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh, here they come.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Come in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll introduce you. This is my girlfriend...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Sup! It's Kurusu Kanako♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ka-Kanako...!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Kanako-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Long time no see, Auntie♪ Nice to meet you, 
Uncle♪

In full put-on mode, Kanako bobbed her head and 
bowed.
However--

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...H-Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...Hey, I just fucked up, didn't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I-It does seem like you did.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...Isn't this bad?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: *ahem*

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Kurusu Kanako-san... was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I'm Kousaka Daisuke, nice to meet you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: H-Huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: No need to be so tense, speak normally.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: It must be tiring to keep up the act.
...Whoa, it was seen through instantly, wasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [font_size=15]...I-diot, there's no way that put-on act would work on Dad.[/font_size]
...That's right...
Dad was extremely skilled at seeing through lies.
It's part of his job, after all.

Kanako who had her put-on specialty sealed then 
says-

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: For real?! I'll just talk normally then~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Geh.

Foolishly honest, she switched to a way of speaking 
that exposed her idiocy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Old man, you understand quite well, dontcha~

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...O-Old man...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Ah, but stuff like acting is Kanako's super specialty, 
so it ain't tiring at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: No need to worriez♪

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
Ah, um, Dear, Kanako-chan is Kirino's classmate, she 
actually visits quite often~!

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Right, Kirino?

Mom quickly changed the subject expecting some 
follow-up, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I'm going upstairs. I'll just be in the way anyways.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey!
Wh-What's up with her?
Don't you normally support your friends, at least?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...About your acting specialty, did you mean your 
club activities or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Huh? No way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Kanako wants to be an idol, to be honest.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Since I plan on singing, dancing, and becoming an 
actress.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Don't mistake that part, alright? Heehee~
...Crap.

This is how her first encounter with her boyfriend's 
parents goes?

I kinda hoped for her to make it through with her 
acting, but-
The way it's going, it was impossible.
Well, it's inevitable.

I'll think of it as "There's no point in this if they 
didn't see her true self".

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hey, Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, what is it, Dad?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...You're fine with this girl?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: -Of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I see.
With a solemn nod, Dad contemplated briefly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: E-Erm...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: D-Dear...
He slowly opened his mouth to speak.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Kyousuke, I trust you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: -You understand what I'm trying to say, right?
